Question Answers: f(a) is defined|the function value exists
Hints: The point must belong to the domain.|Check the actual value first.
Solution: At an interior point, continuity requires (1) f(a) defined, (2) a finite two-sided limit exists, and (3) that limit equals f(a). A hole with a finite limit can be repaired by assigning its limiting value. On a closed interval [a,b] with a<b, use right continuity at a and left continuity at b.
